title: Nice magnet!
text: Nice magnet!. Bought it as a souvenir of a recent trip to Memphis - it's a pleasant reminder!

product_metadata.title: Greetings from Memphis Tennessee Fridge Magnet
features: Deluxe "wrap-around" metal inner shell with a glossy Mylar outer shell
description: This is a charming refrigerator magnet featuring the phrase, "Greetings from Memphis Tennessee." It is in the style of vintage postcards, where pictures of famous local sights would be superimposed on the letters. It is approximately 3"x2". This would make a great way to pay tribute to your hometown or state or display the places you've traveled.
